name: sec-edgar-mcp-server
displayName: SEC EDGAR Filings & Financials Monitor (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4)
description: Keyless Streamable HTTP MCP server & Apify Actor for searching SEC EDGAR filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4), company profiles, and structured XBRL financial metrics.

tools.name: search_sec_filings
tools.description: Search and filter official SEC EDGAR filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4) by ticker or CIK.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Fetch SEC EDGAR company profile (CIK, SIC, tickers, exchanges, fiscal year end).

tools.name: get_company_financials
tools.description: Fetch latest structured XBRL financial metrics (revenue, netIncome, assets, liabilities, cash, EPS) from SEC EDGAR.
